notes: Example fin envelopes only. The pinned clone has no runtime bound on Flipper.amplitude, frequency, zero_direction or phase_offset: moveFins.py copies the message values without a check. The amplitude and direction values below follow the RL training action space (RL_UCAT.py:67-71) as an operator example; they are not device facts, not a runtime clamp and not a recommendation. A real site must replace them with its own assessed envelope.
